name: The Dark West
detailed_description:
The Dark West is an ARPG forged in blood and ruin, for those who live and breathe the genre. Face the cursed frontier, where faith and damnation war beneath an eternal dusk. Every battle is brutal, every choice carves a path through the filth of a world where greed unearthed something fouler than death. Struggle through the wasteland of corruption, where the strong don’t just survive, they decide what’s left to rule.

Step into the dying heart of Blackveil, where the land itself is poisoned by black magic, a force ancient and unyielding, twisting the world into something unrecognizable. It does not grant power, it demands it, turning men into monsters and justice into a whispered lie.

Now, two sides rise in the ruin: The Order, zealots cloaked in justice, wielding iron and faith, blind to the rot spreading in their ranks. The Damned, cursed souls lost to black magic’s grip, their bodies warped, their minds unraveling. In this land, trust is a slow death, and the real danger isn’t what waits in the dark, it’s who’s standing beside you when the killing starts.

Choose Your Fate

Make your outlaw. Pick your class. Wield your own brand of violence to carve through the        horrors ahead. Whether you master the art of gunplay, steel, or the unnatural, you’ll need        every skill, every trick, and every ruthless instinct to stand a chance. No one rides through      the Dark West clean.

Power. Greed. Survival

Arm yourself with weapons steeped in history and horror. Bloodstained steel, hexed                  revolvers, cursed relics that bite deeper than any blade, every tool has a price, and none          come without risk. Experiment with deadly builds, forge your own path, and embrace the          ruthless dance of combat. From scourged firearms to artifacts twisted by black magic,              every weapon at your side could be your savior, or your downfall.

A New Type of Movement

Movement in The Dark West is fluid and realistic, driven by physics and inertia for a natural      yet dynamic feel. Positioning is crucial, and the instant dodge allows last-second evasions      without long animations, rewarding precise timing and smart decision-making in every            battle.

A new take on Inventory System

it’s a living, tactical extension of your journey. Every weapon, armor and trinket tells a story, dynamically shifting as you scavenge to survive. With an intuitive layout built for speed and strategy, quick-access slots keep you locked and loaded. Adapt, optimize, and stay one step ahead, because in the Dark West, every item could mean the difference between life and death."

Only the strongest, the most cunning, and the most ruthless will endure. Face off against legendary abominations, duel vagrants at the edges of the world, and ride through unforgiving frontiers where the dead don’t stay buried. The Dark West does not forgive. Will you tame it, or will you be another soul lost to the hexfire that devours all?

short_description: The Dark West is a grim ARPG reimagining the genre with deep player agency, innovative systems, and a fresh take on player progression. We're crafting an experience that blends cutting-edge gameplay within an engaging and immersive world.
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Thai
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 4 core 2.8GHz x64-compatible
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 960 or ATI Radeon™ RX 470
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: A GPU with at least 3GB of VRAM is required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-10500 or AMD™ Ryzen 5 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® RTX 2060, Intel® Arc™ A770, or ATI Radeon™ RX 5600XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Solid State Storage is recommended
